title: MigrationPlan
description: Schema for a data migration plan. Covers the full scope of a database or data platform migration including inventory, compatibility analysis, type mappings, data movement strategy, reconciliation plan, performance baseline, cutover and rollback plans, decommission approach, risk register, and required approvals.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier for this migration plan.

migration_type.description: Classification of the migration being performed.

source_platform.description: Source data platform name (e.g. Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata).

target_platform.description: Target data platform name (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL).

created_by.description: Identity of the person or agent that created this migration plan.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this migration plan was created.

inventory.description: Inventory of database objects in scope for migration.

items.description: A database object to be migrated (e.g. table, view, procedure, sequence).

compatibility_matrix.description: Analysis of feature compatibility between source and target platforms.

feature.description: Platform feature or construct being assessed.

source_support.description: How the source platform supports this feature.

target_support.description: How the target platform supports this feature.

action.description: Required action to address the compatibility gap (e.g. rewrite, native equivalent, unsupported).

type_mappings.description: Data type mappings from source to target platform types.

source_type.description: Data type as defined in the source platform.

target_type.description: Equivalent data type in the target platform.

notes.description: Notes on precision, scale, or semantic differences between the types.

risk.description: Risk level of this type mapping (e.g. none, low, medium, high).

data_movement_strategy.description: Description of the approach to physically moving data (e.g. bulk extract-load, CDC, dual-write, shadow migration).

reconciliation_plan.description: Plan for validating data completeness and accuracy post-migration.

methods.description: Reconciliation methods to be applied (e.g. row count, checksum, statistical sampling, business rule checks).

acceptance_criteria.description: Criteria that must be met for the reconciliation to be considered passed.

performance_baseline.description: Description of the performance baseline captured from the source system for comparison post-migration.

cutover_plan.description: Description of the cutover approach including sequencing, timing, and go/no-go criteria.

rollback_plan.description: Description of the rollback procedure if the migration fails or is reversed.

retention_and_decommission.description: Plan for retaining source system data and decommissioning the source once migration is verified.

risk_register.description: Risks identified for this migration with likelihood, impact, and mitigation.

likelihood.description: Likelihood of the risk occurring (e.g. low, medium, high).

impact.description: Impact if the risk materialises (e.g. low, medium, high, critical).

mitigation.description: Action or control to reduce the likelihood or impact of this risk.

approvals_required.description: Approvals required before proceeding with migration phases.

role.description: Role or team that must provide approval.

scope.description: What this approval covers (e.g. cutover, rollback, decommission).

status.description: Current status of this approval (e.g. pending, approved, rejected).
